Skills I have written for [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code). A skill is a folder with a `SKILL.md` file that Claude loads when a task matches its description, so the same conventions get applied every time instead of being re-explained in each conversation.

To install one, put its folder in `~/.claude/skills/` (available in every project) or `.claude/skills/` inside a project.
